g.text: Tightness uses only independently verified positive correction-only spectral norms; exact-zero ratios are undefined.
Dotted reference at 1 is the real-arithmetic requirement. Small floating violations are retained; no clipping to 1.
Ratios with a correction graph norm below the full-operator floating scale can be extremely large; all are retained.
Bands: min–max over configurations. Open downward triangles: actual zeros shown at a recorded plotting floor.
